args.command:
SELECT json_object('fields', json_group_array(
  json_object(
    'session_id', session_id,
    'participant_id', participant_id,
    'condition', condition,
    'cognitive_score', cognitive_score,
    'reaction_ms', reaction_ms,
    'recorded_at', recorded_at,
    'status', status,
    'notes', CASE WHEN notes IS NULL THEN '' ELSE quotes(notes) END
  )
)) as json_data
FROM (
    WITH latest_per_session AS (
        SELECT session_id, MAX(recorded_at) as max_rec
        FROM measurements
        GROUP BY session_id
    )
    SELECT m.* FROM measurements m
    JOIN latest_per_session l ON m.session_id = l.session_id AND m.recorded_at = l.max_rec
    ORDER BY m.recorded_at DESC
);
args.summary: Generate JSON using SQLite built-in functions
